meta.name: Routed surface — the governed service path, routing as shipped
meta.description: The third measurement surface. Drives execute_governed_mi_query, so a question is claimed by whichever route claims it in production, and the answer is adjudicated by the guard that actually adjudicates it.
sees: The routing decision itself. Which route claims a question is the thing neither other bank can observe — the calibration bank calls run_mi_agent_query directly and is always point-in-time, and the robustness bank exercises routing but grades only an outcome label.
The verdict and the facet kinds and statuses the guard produced, so a false APPLIED is visible as data rather than only as a wrong sentence.
Behaviour that differs between the routed and point-in-time paths. Four of the six Stage 5 trace questions behave differently on the two.
cannot_see: Numeric correctness. Nothing here checks that a figure is right; it checks which capability answered and what the receipt claimed. The calibration bank remains the only surface that grades numbers.
The LLM parser arm. Deterministic only, like every surface in this programme, for the reason standing condition 1 records.
Any book but alderbridge. The robustness bank is the only two-book surface, so a defect appearing on kestrelmoor alone is invisible here.
Answer TEXT. answer_diff owns that, byte for byte. This asserts structure, so a reworded refusal does not fail it and a changed verdict does.

Anything a route declines to declare. The residual tier of the routed grouping check is unprovable from the payload, so a facet applied on that tier reads the same here as one proven by name. rt_013 is that tier's one demonstrably false member, declared rather than left to read as coverage.

A named dimension the parser slotted as a FILTER. The deterministic parser resolves no categorical filter at all — every filter it fills is a numeric bound on a measure — so no question this surface can ASK reaches the role owner's filter branch. `test_d2_routed_role_carriage.py` constructs the parse instead, and asserts that the day the parser learns categorical filters, that construction can be replaced by a real question here.
